title: Best trumpet players and Yvonne Thomas in Crowley
summary: Buddy, Kid Rena and Chris Kelly compared; Zardis played about three years with Yvonne Thomas in Crowley.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Who was, at that time, say in the 20s, who would you say was regarded as the outstanding trumpet player in the city at that time?

Well, that's the question, though. Buddy was good. Kid Rennie was good. Them two boys were real up to date. Chris Kelly was good. So, the comparison with them, they, all the people say that Rennie was, was the best, because Rennie went up there and he got them high and know he was something like, uh, this boy, Yvonne Thomas, you know what I mean? That's what, uh, Rennie were like. But, uh, they all were good. They all were good.
Did you ever play with Yvonne Thomas?
Yes. I played with Yvonne about, oh, I stayed there about, three years in Crowley, Louisiana. Oh, really?
You weren't there when he was killed, was he?
He got killed, oh, that's a long time after I left. Yes.
Yeah, well, I, well, I was back here then. I was waking out there on that boat there with the Pichon on the steam of capital at that time.
